answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 31463 Country: India Title: Dua after farz namaz jamaat should be ijtimaee or infiraadee. Question: Dua after farz namaz jamaat should be ijtimaee or infiraadee. that is, people should ask dua secretely from Allah or the imaam says dua loudly and the people say aameen. which is corect? Answer ID: 31463 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 709/L=258/tl=1432) After Imam turns for salam the connection that is between Imam and muqtadi comes to an end. Now muqtadi is not the follower of the imam. Hence, each person should make his dua individually after performing fardh salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
